verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an agent-building framework, so consuming tools from MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no evidence that Pipecat can connect to MCP servers as a client. The only MCP mention is `pipecat context-hub install`, which registers Pipecat's docs hub as an MCP server for your coding agent; that is the opposite (server) role and does not count here. Flows function-calling for external APIs is an adjacent building block, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
